environment.description: ECS Fargate service in isolated subnet with identical application code. Container task definition injects DATABASE_URL from AWS Secrets Manager (secret: prod/myapp/db-readonly). The secret contains credentials for PostgreSQL role 'app_ro_svc' which was provisioned via Terraform module 'rds-iam-roles' with a narrowly scoped GRANT. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and pgaudit extension enabled. CloudWatch Container Insights monitors query patterns. The ECS service uses awsvpc networking mode with a security group allowing inbound only from the internal ALB.

config.db_role_definition: CREATE ROLE app_ro_svc LOGIN; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_ro_svc; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_ro_svc; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_ro_svc; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM app_ro_svc;
config.network: Internal ALB -> ECS Fargate (awsvpc, sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f), no public ingress
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Container Insights, pgaudit logging to CloudWatch Logs
